products.name: SteerCommand Z2
products.tagline: Year-round control and high-accuracy steering in a complete package.
products.description: SteerCommand Z2 is Ag Leader's integrated hydraulic steering system, controlled by the year-round InCommand Go displays for industry-leading visibility and control. It provides integrated steering directly to the vehicle CAN bus or hydraulic valve, with user-guided step-by-step calibration and easy tuning from the run screen. SteerCommand Z2 pairs with Ag Leader GPS 6500 and GPS 7500 receivers and a range of correction sources (WAAS to RTK) to match the accuracy needed for any operation, and is upgradable with TurnPath (automated end-of-row turns) and RightPath (passive implement steering).

It pairs with an Ag Leader GPS receiver and correction source options to deliver pass-to-pass accuracy from WAAS to RTK. With 13 possible motor orientation options and a detachable, portable motor, SteadySteer installs easily on hundreds of agricultural vehicles and is designed for fast, powerful line acquisition even in tough terrain. products.name: GPS 7500
products.tagline: Full-featured receiver that can be used in all precision operations from basic to advanced.
products.description: The GPS 7500 is Ag Leader's full-featured GPS receiver compatible with manual guidance, assisted steering (SteadySteer), and integrated steering (SteerCommand Z2). It supports the widest range of differential correction sources — WAAS/EGNOS/GLIDE, TerraStar-L, TerraStar-C PRO, TerraStar-X, and RTK with RTK ASSIST — with dual frequency performance on WAAS and multi-constellation, multi-frequency performance on RTK. products.name: DualTrac
products.tagline: A high-accuracy, dual antenna steering solution for any speed on the farm, down to 0.05 mph (0.08 km/h).
products.description: DualTrac is Ag Leader's dual-antenna, high-accuracy steering solution built for ultra-low-speed precision, performing reliably at speeds as low as 0.05 mph (0.08 km/h). It uses two GPS 7500 receivers to provide the most accurate heading for autosteer, maintaining a stable heading even when the vehicle is not in motion. Pairing with SteerCommand Z2 for high-performance integrated hydraulic steering, DualTrac uses RTK, TerraStar-X, or NTRIP to achieve sub-inch (less than 2.5 cm) accuracy — ideal for specialty crops, vegetables, fruits, transplanting, bedding, drip tape, and other slow-speed field operations.

products.tagline: Hands-free steering for automatic, repeatable end-of-row turns.
products.description: TurnPath is a one-time-fee unlock that automates end-of-row turns, eliminating the need for manual operation during turns and improving precision. Controlled by the InCommand or InCommand Go display, it benefits every field activity from tillage and planting to spraying and harvesting, and can be tried free for 24 hours via a trial activation from the display. TurnPath requires an unlocked InCommand or InCommand Go display, SteerCommand Z2 or SteadySteer, and a GPS 7500, 7000, 6500, or 6000 receiver.

products.name: RightPath
products.tagline: Now available! Passive implement steering to keep your implement centered on the guidance line.
products.description: RightPath is a passive implement steering upgrade that keeps the implement — not just the vehicle — centered on the guidance line, ensuring precise input placement, increased operational efficiency, and minimized crop damage and yield loss. Without implement steering, an implement can drift off the intended guidance line by 10 inches or more even on flat ground. RightPath displays cross track error for both vehicle and implement, supports satellite-based corrections (TerraStar-C PRO, TerraStar-X) or RTK, and is compatible with Ag Leader integrated and assisted steering systems across mixed fleets of new or older equipment.

products.name: SureForce
products.tagline: Planter hydraulic downforce with uplift.
products.description: SureForce is Ag Leader's hydraulic planter downforce system with uplift, controlled by the InCommand Go 16 display. It instantly applies or removes force to give each row the exact pressure needed for ideal planting depth, replacing manual springs or airbags that can lag up to 20 seconds. SureForce is the most powerful downforce system on the market, maintaining depth in no-till conditions, varying soil types, heavy residue, and compacted areas, while hydraulic uplift prevents sidewall compaction by removing excess weight on the gauge wheels. It offers row-level monitoring, downforce-applied mapping, and works across 1 to 36 row planter configurations.

products.name: SureSpeed
products.tagline: A high-accuracy seed meter and delivery system providing superior in-ground seed placement at any speed up to 12 mph.
products.description: SureSpeed is a high-accuracy, aftermarket seed meter and delivery system offering superior in-ground seed placement at any speed up to 12 mph. Its unique meter design and flighted delivery belt — with the lowest release point in the industry — maximize singulation and spacing at all speeds. Built with durable, individually replaceable components (24-volt system, brushless DC motors, Kevlar-reinforced belt), SureSpeed offers unmatched longevity and the lowest cost of ownership in its class. It retrofits most Case IH, Harvest International, John Deere, Kinze, and White planters, supports up to 54 rows, and is tool-free for crop changeover across corn, soybean, wheat/barley, cotton, sugar beet/milo, and sunflower disks.

products.name: SureDrive
products.tagline: Electric drives for your planter utilizing your existing meter.
products.description: SureDrive is a maintenance-free electric drive that upgrades an existing planter meter with individual row-section control, variable-rate/prescription-based population control, and turn compensation. Each SureDrive row also acts as an individual section shutoff, reducing overlap, wasted seed, and lodged plants, and it automatically adjusts meter speed on each row to keep consistent population around turns, contours, and terraces. Its robust, sealed construction — four cold-forged, high-grade steel gears, precision bearings, and a drive chain submersed in full synthetic fluid — eliminates the maintenance of chains and bearings in traditional planter drive systems.

products.name: SureStop
products.tagline: SureStop electric row clutches turn planter sections on and off, row-by-row using automatic row shutoffs.
products.description: SureStop electric row clutches provide individual or per-section row shutoff control to eliminate double planting at end rows, point rows, and partial swaths — lowering seed cost, increasing yield through even spacing, and increasing productivity by removing the need to slow down at end rows. The 12V clutches mount on each row between the hex shaft and seed meter, use a rugged sealed design for year-after-year durability, and install on popular brand and model planters. Controlled by the InCommand Go displays, SureStop delivers pristine point rows and reduced seed waste.

products.name: RightSpot
products.tagline: Individual nozzle-by-nozzle sprayer control.
products.description: RightSpot delivers instant nozzle-by-nozzle swath control, supporting up to 144 nozzles, with flow rate and pressure controlled independently for consistent coverage across a wide range of speeds and terrain. Using Blended Pulse technology, RightSpot's electric solenoids pulse at 10 or 20 Hz to eliminate skips and maintain precise boom pressure and droplet size, including turn compensation that increases flow on faster-moving outer nozzles and decreases flow on slower inner nozzles when spraying curves. Controlled by the InCommand Go 16 display, RightSpot is upgradable with BoomLoop for automated boom recirculation and fits most common self-propelled and pull-type sprayer brands including John Deere, Case, Hagie, Rogator, and Apache.

products.tagline: Precision liquid application, elevated efficiency.
products.description: DirectCommand L2 provides section control for up to 36 boom sections with variable-rate application, controlling liquid controllers, planters, sprayers, and NH3 applicators from a single system. It's a buildable platform — when ready for nozzle-by-nozzle precision, growers can easily upgrade from DirectCommand L2 to RightSpot. Controlled by the InCommand Go displays, it offers droplet size monitoring, vapor state monitoring and tube-check safety alerts for NH3/anhydrous toolbars, spinner spreader control with container sequencing, and planter liquid rate control options including electric pump and flowmeter/valve wiring integration.

products.name: BoomLoop
products.tagline: A simple, effective way to prime without spraying while reducing product buildup in the boom.
products.description: BoomLoop is a fully-integrated, automated recirculation solution for sprayers equipped with RightSpot, creating a streamlined path for product to flow from the ends of the boom back to the tank — eliminating dead spots and buildup opportunities. It automates priming so spray solution fills the entire boom without dispensing to the ground, and automatically sequences section valves so the whole boom is primed or flushed even when folded or not level. BoomLoop is controlled entirely from the InCommand Go 16 display, with visual and audible alerts when active, and lets operators prime/agitate the boom while folding up and driving to the next field.

products.name: Granular (DirectCommand Granular)
products.tagline: DirectCommand Granular Applicator transforms the application process, providing maximum control and efficiency.
products.description: DirectCommand Granular gives spinner spreaders and toolbar applicators AutoSwath (automatic on/off based on field boundaries and already-applied areas), variable-rate application of up to three products, container sequencing with independent container-level monitoring, and easy SmartReport generation with location, product info, applied totals, and as-applied maps. Controlled by the InCommand Go displays, it supports strip-till fertilizer control (up to three granular products alongside anhydrous and nitrogen stabilizer) and spinner spreader control with sequential multi-product application.

products.name: Yield Monitor
products.tagline: Real-time, accurate yield data for crucial decision-making.
products.description: Ag Leader's Yield Monitor is the time-tested, gold-standard benchmark for combine yield and moisture mapping, trusted on thousands of machines worldwide since 1992. Live yield and moisture mapping instantly show how field conditions affect yield while harvesting, with trustworthy yield data achievable in as little as two calibration loads. It installs on many makes and models at the factory, and aftermarket kits fit most combines made in the last 35 years, using the combine's original elevator chain and, in many cases, existing flow and moisture sensors and elevator mount unit. Controlled by the InCommand Go displays, it includes resettable bushel counters to track grain in the tank.

products.name: CartACE
